decks.notes: This deck focuses on utilizing powerful artifacts and fast mana to control the game early and maintain tempo. By leveraging cards like Sol Ring, Moxen, Time Walk, and Ancestral Recall, the deck aims to quickly deploy threats like Sphinx of the Steel Wind and White Plume Adventurer to pressure the opponent. Additionally, disruptive elements like Lavinia, Azorius Renegade and Hullbreacher can disrupt the opponent's game plan, while cards like Tinker and Karn, the Great Creator provide versatile answers to various situations. The deck's goal is to establish a strong board presence while keeping the opponent on the back foot.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of powerful artifacts and counterspells. By using cards like Force of Will and Flusterstorm to protect key pieces such as Time Vault, Mana Crypt, and Black Lotus, the player can outmaneuver their opponent and maintain dominance. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion adds another layer of versatility and resilience. The engineers, Goblin Engineer and Lavinia, Azorius Renegade, provide additional utility in finding or protecting essential artifacts. Overall, this deck aims to outsmart and outlast the opponent through strategic and efficient gameplay.

This deck focuses on utilizing low-cost and efficient threats, disruption, and tempo plays to pressure the opponent and control the game. With cards like Deathrite Shaman, Lavinia, Azorius Renegade, and Swords to Plowshares, the deck aims to establish early board presence while disrupting the opponent's plans. The inclusion of cards like Force of Will and Mental Misstep provides additional disruption against opposing strategies, while the card advantage from Ancestral Recall and Treasure Cruise keeps the deck flowing smoothly. With a mix of aggro creatures and control elements, this deck seeks to outmaneuver opponents and secure victory swiftly.

This deck aims to control the game by utilizing powerful spells and artifact ramp to outvalue the opponent. With a focus on counter spells, card advantage, and combo potential with cards like Tinker and Time Vault, the deck looks to disrupt the opponent's strategy while assembling its own win conditions. By using versatile cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Narset, Parter of Veils, the deck can slow down opponents and manipulate the game to its advantage. With access to powerful Esper colors and key artifact synergies, the deck aims to dominate the game through control and resource manipulation.

This deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan by playing hatebear creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Archon of Emeria, which impose restrictions on their spells. It also includes cards like Chancellor of the Annex and Phyrexian Censor to further disrupt their plays. The aggro strategy of the deck is supported by creatures like Solitude and White Plume Adventurer, while also utilizing mana acceleration from Moxen and lands like Ancient Tomb. Additionally, the deck includes disruptive lands like Strip Mine and Wasteland to hinder the opponent's mana base.

The deck focuses on fast aggro plays with hatebear creatures that disrupt opponents' strategies, combined with powerful mana acceleration to quickly deploy threats. The goal is to overwhelm opponents with disruptive creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Archon of Emeria while using cards like Chancellor of the Annex to further hinder opponents' spells. The deck also includes cards like Solitude and Anointed Peacekeeper for removal and protection. Overall, the deck aims to control the game through disruptive creatures and powerful synergy between its cards.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan with hatebears like Thalia and Chancellor of the Annex, while applying pressure with aggro creatures like White Plume Adventurer and Seasoned Dungeoneer. The deck also utilizes cards like Archon of Emeria to slow down the opponent's spells and Emeria's Call for extra creatures. With a mana denial strategy using cards like Wasteland and Strip Mine, the deck aims to control the pace of the game and limit the opponent's options while building a board presence to secure victory.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling the Coveted Jewel combo using artifacts and mana acceleration, while utilizing cards like Tinker, Trinisphere, Force of Will, and Urza's Saga to control the game. The main strategy is to generate a large amount of mana using cards like Mishra's Workshop, Grim Monolith, and Paradoxical Outcome, and then use cards like Coveted Jewel and Karn, the Great Creator to gain a substantial advantage. The deck aims to win the game through a combination of card advantage, mana acceleration, and powerful artifact synergies.

This deck focuses on quickly disrupting the opponent's plays while establishing a strong board presence through a mix of cheap spells and powerful artifacts. By utilizing disruptive creatures like Lavinia, Azorius Renegade and Hullbreacher alongside counterspells and removal like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares, the deck aims to control the game tempo and prevent the opponent from executing their game plan. At the same time, the deck utilizes powerful artifacts like Time Vault and Bolas's Citadel to generate card advantage and close out the game quickly once the opponent's defenses have been breached.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of counter spells, card draw, and removal. The key strategy revolves around using Oath of Druids to cheat out powerful creatures, such as Atraxa, Grand Unifier, Minsc & Boo, Timeless Heroes, and Narset, Parter of Veils. These creatures are supported by disruptive spells like Mental Misstep, Flusterstorm, Pyroblast, and Force of Will to ensure protection and disruption of opponents' strategies. Additionally, the deck includes efficient removal options like Lightning Bolt and Wrenn and Six. Overall, the goal is to maintain control of the game while leveraging the power of Oath of Druids to quickly establish a dominant board presence.

The deck focuses on putting pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan through hatebear creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Archon of Emeria. By utilizing cards like Chancellor of the Annex and Ancient Tomb, the deck aims to slow down the opponent's plays and control the board. With a mix of aggro creatures and disruptive elements, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and restrict their options, ultimately leading to victory through a combination of creature damage and control elements.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and aggressively utilize the Bazaar of Baghdad ability to discard cards and bring back powerful creatures like Vengevine and Hollow One from the graveyard. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Force of Will, Mindbreak Trap, and Force of Negation to protect its game plan. The inclusion of cards like Noxious Revival and Serum Powder helps to ensure consistency and efficiency while maintaining pressure on the opponent. Overall, the deck relies on fast graveyard interactions and powerful creatures to overwhelm the opponent.

The deck focuses on using various tutors and draw spells to set up a powerful combo involving Doomsday and Thassa's Oracle to win the game quickly. It includes a mix of fast mana, disruption, and card selection to efficiently find and assemble the combo pieces. The deck aims to execute its game plan quickly and protect it with countermagic like Force of Will and Flusterstorm. The key strategy is to use Doomsday effectively and efficiently to win the game in a single turn.

This deck focuses on aggressive creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Stoneforge Mystic while disrupting the opponent's game plan with hate cards like Chalice of the Void and Archon of Emeria. By deploying early threats and using disruptive elements, this deck aims to outpace and overwhelm the opponent before they can execute their own strategies. With a mana base designed to support quick creature deployment and disruption, this deck aims to control the tempo of the game and secure victory through efficient aggression and disruption.

The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Archon of Emeria to disrupt opponent's strategies while ramping into powerful spells using mana acceleration such as Chrome Mox and Ancient Tomb. It also employs hate cards like Chancellor of the Annex and Wasteland to further disrupt opponent's plans. The deck aims to control the board and outpace opponents with its efficient creatures and disruptive spells, ultimately overwhelming them with its aggressive game plan.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay with a specific emphasis on disrupting the opponent's strategy and gaining card advantage. It includes a strong selection of card draw spells and tutors to consistently find key cards. The deck also utilizes a mix of counter spells and removal spells to control the board. It features a companion card, Lurrus of the Dream-Den, which allows for recursion of low-cost permanents. The mana base is well-rounded, allowing for flexibility in casting spells of multiple colors. Overall, the deck aims to apply early pressure while maintaining control over the game.
